Vendored from https://github.com/RainbowCookie32/rusty-psn at commit e841f26c1b052dc35f85984b02253ce8c4e5f711 (MIT License, see LICENSE). Built as the CLI variant (--no-default-features --features cli) and shipped as rusty-psn-cli.exe.
Cargo.lock: root package version bumped 0.5.10 -> 0.6.0 to match Cargo.toml (upstream lock was stale), so --locked builds work.
RPCS3 Slim: adds a --json mode (src/cli/json.rs) and parses ps3_system_ver, for RPCS3's Game Update Downloader dialog.
